name: Guardrails
description: Refuses dangerous commands and the reading of secrets before they run. You let one through once, in a click, from its tab.
author: Hangar

gallery.permissionsSummary: Runs a hook before each Bash, Read, Edit, Write and Grep call that can refuse it, shows a tab listing the refusals, and keeps them with its one-time passes in the kit's own data folder.
